commands.purpose: Exercise Project Docs browser identity, pages, metadata, keyboard operation, and viewport behavior with positive and negative browser paths.
Inspect Project Docs canonical-origin, robots, and sitemap outputs against the declared discovery contract, including negative drift cases.

releaseGates.purpose: Block release unless the Project Docs browser proof command covers all browser-facing Website records.
Block release unless the Project Docs discovery proof command covers all discovery records.

implementationBoundary.description: This consumer-owned Project Docs file implements the declared Website target.

positiveEvidence.description: The browser proof loads Project Docs and observes the declared browser identity asset.
positiveEvidence.expectedResult: The declared browser-facing behavior is observed in a real browser.

negativeEvidence.description: The browser proof fails when the declared browser identity asset is missing or not used.
negativeEvidence.expectedResult: The proof fails when the declared browser-facing behavior is intentionally violated.
